method: Repeated sparse propagation q_(t+1)=P.T @ q_t; expected pre-selection window law=sum(q_t)/length.
numerical_scope: Existing finite-grid transition matrices; selection integration error is documented in the original input audit. These are deterministic expectations, not Monte Carlo estimates or continuous-state equilibrium claims.

source_input_audit.state_definition: Mature reputation x in [0,1]; Beta(1+x/(1-rho),1+(1-x)/(1-rho)); only the selected seller updates.

demand.interpretation: Order doubling over the whole grid and independent adaptive quadrature at selected nodes; observed errors are diagnostics, not rigorous global error bounds. Direct Beta-draw selection matches the numerical kernel up to demand integration error.

source_input_audit.provenance_note: Current files are hashed separately from the historical solver hashes saved in each source manifest. Loaded policies and stationary laws are checked under the current actual-game kernel; no equilibrium solver was run.
